engine.07: It normalizes types and variants, turns each product into a point in a 1,024-dimension space and builds your store's graph.
engine.08: Paid orders and abandoned checkouts from the last 12 months, weighted by spend and quantity, with decay over time (collaborative filtering).
engine.09: Similar, bought together, recommended for you, complementary, from the cart: each with a score and a reason, and with variety quotas so you don't see the same product ten times.
engine.10: Proprietary statistical models, calibrated on your store and your inventory: the weights, the graph and the stock filter are yours, and one brand's data never feeds another.

faq.02: Does it work with my theme?
faq.03: Yes. You add the blocks from the Shopify theme editor. Cards can inherit the style of your theme's product card, recognized automatically, or use one of the six Neurocart styles.
faq.05: No. You install the app, connect the store to the panel with a code and choose your settings. Your theme code stays untouched.
faq.07: Each store has its own model and graph, isolated from the others. We handle Shopify's GDPR compliance webhooks: deleting a customer or a store propagates across the whole platform. We are an Italian company.
faq.09: Can I manage more than one store?
faq.10: Yes. One account, several Shopify stores, with owner and collaborator roles. Each store has its own plan and credits, and your team can follow several stores from the same console.
faq.11: What happens if the bot can't answer?
faq.12: If someone on your team is online, the customer can ask to talk to them; otherwise they leave a message and you get an email. If nobody replies within the time you set, the chat goes back to the bot.
faq.13: How much does a conversation cost?
faq.14: Each plan includes a quota of conversations: 30 on Base, 100 on Pro. Beyond that, you buy packs of 10 from the panel, which don't expire. We count per conversation, not per message.
